user.title: Select Schneider Ambient device
user.description: Select a Schneider/WSC mirror or mirror cabinet currently visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Pair Schneider Ambient device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Press the physical pairing button on the light/mirror cabinet now. Keep the device in pairing mode, then select Submit to continue. PacketLogger analysis did not show standard BLE SMP bonding in the captured app session, so this step reproduces the required physical-button procedure without claiming a Bluetooth bond was created.

abort.device_not_found: The selected device is no longer visible. Press the physical pairing button on the light/mirror cabinet and try again.
abort.no_devices_found: No compatible Schneider/WSC device was found. Make sure a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online, press the physical pairing button on the light/mirror cabinet, then try again.
abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported by this integration.
